metadata.indication: First-line metastatic or unresectable recurrent HNSCC with PD-L1 CPS ≥1.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

contexts.duration_text: Up to 6 combination cycles, then pembrolizumab every 21 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00706 Version 3. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

eligibility: Adults with first-line metastatic or unresectable recurrent head-and-neck squamous cell carcinoma, histologically/cytologically confirmed and considered incurable by local therapies.
Adequate haematological, renal and hepatic function; confirm full clinical eligibility before treatment.
exclusions: Progression within six months of completing curatively intended systemic treatment for locoregionally advanced HNSCC.
A medical condition requiring immunosuppressive systemic steroids above 10 mg prednisolone equivalent/day or other immunosuppressants (excluding inhaled/topical steroids).
Active clinically significant infection requiring therapy.
Severe renal impairment; significant hearing impairment/tinnitus.

notes: Pre/post cisplatin hydration/electrolytes per local policy; antidiarrhoeal treatment as required.
G-CSF/antibiotic support follows cytotoxic neutropenia/FN pathways; immune toxicity assessed separately.

administration.notes: Over 30 minutes before chemotherapy; source filter/dilution requirements apply.
Four daily 22-hour infusions. Alternative: 2000 mg/m2 over 48 hours on days 1–2, repeated days 3–4 (4000 mg/m2 total over 96 hours). Confirm the prescribed pump schedule.
Over 30 minutes. Transition needs treating-team decision; source does not set a fixed 24-month cap.

cautions: Prior anti-PD-1/PD-L1 treatment: consult current NCCP eligibility guidance rather than inferring eligibility.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, glucose, TFT, hepatitis B (HBsAg/core antibody), HCV, validated PD-L1 CPS, DPD before first fluorouracil unless already tested.
Before every cycle: FBC, renal/liver profile and glucose. Thyroid function every 3–6 weeks.
Audiology/CrCl if clinically indicated; assess cisplatin hearing/tinnitus/sensory symptoms each cycle.
Disease monitoring follows individual Consultant plan; no universal mandatory imaging/tumour-marker interval.
